epics.title: Rollback guardian
epics.summary: Build independent detection, reversible recovery, notification and production drills for the targets in 07-ROLLBACK-GUARDIAN.md. Activation follows owner final acceptance.

tasks.title: Define target inventory and known-good evidence
decisions: Use immutable deployment IDs, source SHAs and artifact digests; never infer known-good from latest.
Unknown Cloudflare targets remain disabled until inventoried.
tasks.current_state: There is no per-target production inventory or verified known-good record.
tasks.desired_state: Each enabled target has a validated inventory entry and retained prior good ID with health evidence.
acceptance: Reject missing digest, stale health proof and unknown target in offline fixtures.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Bounded schema and deterministic fixture work.

tasks.title: Run independent cloud probes and correlate failures
decisions: Use a scheduled workflow separate from shipping jobs and outside the operator PC.
Tie smoke, health and error-rate evidence to the actual deployment ID.
tasks.current_state: Post-deploy and scheduled production probes are absent.
tasks.desired_state: An independent monitor records post-merge/post-deploy smoke, endpoint and synthetic results without treating missing telemetry as green.
acceptance: Offline fixtures cover bad deploy, provider outage, two-vantage disagreement and missing metrics.
Monitor cannot use shipping-agent approval or a PC-only trigger.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Isolated monitoring workflow and testable correlation logic.

tasks.title: Gate rollback decisions and suppress loops
decisions: Rollback only the immediately preceding verified good target after correlated failure.
Escalate migration, security, uncertain attribution, missing target and repeated failure.
tasks.current_state: No independent rollback policy or one-attempt lock exists.
tasks.desired_state: A deterministic decision record precedes every action and fails closed on nonreversible cases.
acceptance: Fixtures prove threshold, cooldown, one attempt per deployment and escalation behavior.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Safety policy can be tested without production access.

tasks.title: Prepare Cloudflare Pages recovery adapter
decisions: Restore a retained known-good Pages deployment only after verifying provider API and permissions.
Keep dry-run as default and probe the resulting production deployment ID.
tasks.current_state: No opt-in Pages rollback path is wired.
tasks.desired_state: A tested adapter can restore a verified prior deployment when authorized and enabled.
acceptance: Provider API and permission assumptions are recorded as verified evidence before live use.
Fixtures reject unretained or mismatched deployment IDs.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Target-specific reversible adapter with no live activation.

tasks.title: Prepare Cloudflare Worker version recovery
decisions: Restore a prior verified Worker version/deployment; verify provider API and traffic semantics.
Keep dry-run as default and validate the live route after an authorized rollback.
tasks.current_state: No opt-in Worker version rollback path is wired.
tasks.desired_state: A tested adapter can restore a verified prior Worker version when authorized and enabled.
acceptance: Provider API and permission assumptions are recorded as verified evidence before live use.
Fixtures reject unknown version and traffic mismatch.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Target-specific version recovery with an offline test seam.

tasks.title: Prepare pinned GitHub Pages recovery
decisions: Build or deploy only a retained good artifact or pinned good SHA from a trusted workflow.
Do not assume current workflow_dispatch restores a prior revision.
tasks.current_state: deploy-docs.yml manual dispatch checks out the current default branch (.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml:13,29-30).
tasks.desired_state: A separate recovery workflow can restore a verified prior docs artifact and probe the public URL.
acceptance: Offline tests reject arbitrary SHA and missing retained artifact.
GitHub Pages deployment behavior and retention are verified before activation.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: A bounded trusted recovery path avoids default-branch replay.

tasks.title: Retain and restore the previous local Xavier binary
decisions: A separate systemd watchdog keeps a checksum-verified previous binary and atomically swaps the service target.
Never rewind SQLite data or retry a failed rollback indefinitely.
tasks.current_state: The local systemd install has no independent previous-binary watchdog (docs/design/trunk-based/facts/FACTS.md:9).
tasks.desired_state: The watchdog can restore the retained binary and verify service health, with installation disabled until accepted.
acceptance: Nonproduction drill restores the prior checksum-verified binary and records post-swap smoke.
Failed smoke stops retries and escalates without touching data.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Local script and unit files are reviewable before installation.

tasks.title: Record incidents and notify the owner
decisions: Send the decision and result to the operator app (Atlas) and one GitHub incident issue per target/deployment.
Do not put secrets, personal paths or operator-app internals in evidence.
tasks.current_state: Production rollback evidence and owner notifications are not linked.
tasks.desired_state: Every decision and action has a deduplicated incident and independently retried owner notification.
acceptance: Fixtures cover duplicate events, delivery outage, redaction and successful later retry.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Generic notification boundary and incident evidence can be tested offline.

tasks.title: Handle source reverts and public release incidents
decisions: Use a gated revert PR only for confidently attributable reversible code.
Never move a published tag or overwrite release assets; prepare a corrective release for owner authorization.
tasks.current_state: Code, deployed binary and published tag recovery are conflated in incident handling.
tasks.desired_state: Incident handling separates gated code revert from prepared corrective publication.
acceptance: Offline fixtures prove migration/security cases do not auto-revert and published tags remain unchanged.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Recovery policy and release preparation are bounded and reversible.

tasks.title: Drill rollback and report production MTTR
decisions: Run nonproduction failure, false-positive, missing-target and guardian-outage drills.
Measure production MTTR separately from integration MTTR.
tasks.current_state: No target-specific recovery drills or production MTTR series exist.
tasks.desired_state: Evidence shows recovery and escalation work before production activation, with per-target timing metrics.
acceptance: Drills cover each target and both success and escalation paths.
Reports include detection, decision, restoration, false positives and unresolved cases.
Diff is at most 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Offline drills and measurement establish activation evidence.

tasks.title: Create credentials and enable accepted production targets
decisions: Owner reviews the Product Acceptance Package, creates least-privilege credentials and authorizes each target's production automation.
Activation is per target after verified provider API, dry-run and rollback drill evidence.
tasks.current_state: Guardian implementations remain disabled and have no production credentials.
tasks.desired_state: Only owner-authorized targets have credentials and active independent monitoring/rollback.
acceptance: Product Acceptance Package records explicit target authorization and credential ownership without secret values.
First activation produces an incident/notification drill and verified known-good record.
No source diff; task is within 4 files and 400 changed lines.
tasks.agent_reason: Human work is limited to credential creation and enabling production automation after final acceptance.
